text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Buena Vista—do not stand in My way!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
There is only one King. And that is I, 
Orfevre! Haaaaaaaaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(Orfe-san...! I'm... being swallowed 
up...!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(This might be the first time I've ever 
felt... that I might not be able to beat 
someone.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(An intense light unlike anyone else's... 
You truly are worthy of a new era.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(...Truth be told, I should probably step 
aside gracefully.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
('We're leaving the rest to you...' 
Entrusted with everyone's hopes—)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —Still...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —I still... won't back down! Haaaaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Suddenly. I felt a refreshing breeze blow 
through my heart.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (—Trainer!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Does it reach you? Can you feel it...? —My 
feelings for you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for always being by my side. 
Thank you for always cheering me on.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for chasing this dream with me. 
Thank you... for giving me my sparkle!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —All of my feelings... reach them!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Before I knew it, I found myself gazing 
at Buena Vista... as she stood in the 
winner's circle.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Not merely a vessel to receive, but one 
who seeks it herself. That too is the 
quality of a queen—befitting one who built 
an entire era.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: And—... I see. Your canes are one another.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Your eyes are sparkling, Trainer. ...It's 
my favorite kind of light.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I'm sure everything... has gotten 
through to you by now.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I can feel... your feelings, too.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Trainer. ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Chasing after me without looking away for 
even a second. Believing in me—so 
straightforwardly.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Thank you... for becoming my Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—Please let me keep being your 
breathtaking view, forever and always.
